text:
maya: heads up — metering-ingest alerted: orphaned aggregation count jumped to ~3.9% for the hourly window ending 2024-11-08T09:00Z. Dashboard spike at https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/metering/orphans :eyes:
ops-bot: incident 9921 created (severity: P2) — paging oncall.
alex: possible culprits: late edge events + shard reassign during compaction, or watermark regression after midnight rollover.
jordan: ran quick query, see sample:
```
SELECT hour_window, count(*) AS orphaned
FROM metering.events
WHERE aggregation_key IS NULL
  AND ingest_time >= '2024-11-08T08:00:00Z'
  AND ingest_time < '2024-11-08T09:00:00Z'
GROUP BY hour_window;
```
jordan: shows concentration on two edge shards (s-32, s-33) — ingest latency tail ~2.3s higher.
maya: did we recently roll the route-resolver? we had a canary last night that changed `session_fingerprint` derivation.
taylor: yeah, rolled 03:12 UTC small tweak to header parsing. canary rate 5% but shadowing enabled. maybe shadow path not setting `aggregation_key` consistently.
alex: if shadow writes differ, downstream dedupe/joins could drop aggregation_key. We need to check the clientlib header mapping in the canary build.
jordan: filed PR #4256 to add stricter header fallback. Quick check: `curl` sampling shows missing `X-Session-Fingerprint` for ~0.6% requests on canary route.
maya: impact matrix — top 10 tenants account for 74% of orphaned tokens this hour. billing-team: can we hold invoice previews for affected tenants and mark as 'suspect'?
billing-team: yes, we can annotate previews with `metering_flag: suspect_orphans` and skip auto-finalize until recon. Need an ETA for fix.
alex: short-term mitigation: patch ingestion to accept fingerprint from `client_id` fallback if `aggregation_key` missing, and tag records `repaired_by_fallback=true`. That avoids gaps but will slightly inflate attribution risk.
taylor: agree. I'll ship a hotfix to ingest-sidecar, push to canary (10%) then 100% if stable. reverting will be quick.
jordan: also suggest adding a new telemetry counter `orphaned_by_shard` and a Grafana alert on >1% for 5m rolling.
maya: ops-bot, please add runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood/metering-orphaned-events
ops-bot: runbook attached to incident 9921. :white_check_mark:
alex: postmortem action items: (1) harden header mapping tests, (2) add end-to-end golden path test for aggregation_key preservation, (3) alert + SLA dashboard update, (4) annotate invoices during recon windows.
taylor: cadence: hotfix -> monitor 30m -> promote -> full rollout. I'll start a rollout chat in #release-war-room.
maya: thanks team. I'll coordinate customer comms for the top impacted tenants.
billing-team: holding previews now, will confirm when it's safe to finalize. :thumbsup:
